title: IELTS Speaking Part 2: educational TV programme
body:
Here's a recent exam question that somebody sent me. How would you answer?

_**Describe an educational television programme that you liked.**_

_**You should say**_

_**\- what the programme was about**_

_**\- when and where you saw it**_

_**\- how you found out about this programme**_

_**\- and why you liked it.**_
